newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU SETS SWEDISH MARKETING INFO VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: VNU SETS SWEDISH MARKETING INFO VENTURE.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Friday it had set up a marketing information joint venture in Sweden in partnership with the Swedish firm EBC Information.
VNU said the joint venture marked the entry of its Claritas Europe marketing information services unit into the Nordic region of Europe.
The Dutch company described EBS Information as a market research firm with some 20 employees and operations in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark.
